symbols.description: Read-only file system across applications. Application B uses application A's appId to inspect, open and read a known file path from application A; this class does not provide write operations.

members.name: openSync
members.description: Open a file in read-only mode

members.name: statSync
members.description: Get file information, or undefined when the file does not exist

members.name: readSync
members.description: Read file content into a buffer

members.name: readFileSync
members.description: Read an entire file. Returns a string when encoding is specified, otherwise an ArrayBuffer.

symbols.description: Read-only JSON key-value storage across applications. Application A publishes data with `ShareLocalStorage` from `@zos/storage`, and application B reads it with application A's appId. When using a custom storagePath, both applications must use the same path.

members.name: getItem
members.description: Get a value, or return the default value when not found
members.signature: getItem<T = any>(key: string, defaultValue?: T): T | undefined

members.name: isExisted
members.description: Check whether the target shared storage file exists

symbols.description: Read-only typed key-value storage across applications. Application A publishes system properties with `ShareTypedStorage` from `@zos/storage`, and application B reads them with application A's appId. When using a custom scope, both applications must use the same scope.

members.name: getBool
members.description: Get a boolean value from the target application

members.name: getInt
members.description: Get an integer value from the target application

members.name: getInt64
members.description: Get a 64-bit integer value from the target application

members.name: getDouble
members.description: Get a double value from the target application

members.name: getString
members.description: Get a string value from the target application
